repair_policy.emergency_definition: Water that cannot be stopped, no toilet in the home, sewage backing up, or no heating/hot water in winter for a vulnerable tenant.
repair_policy.small_repairs_rule: Besluit kleine herstellingen: small repairs (e.g. tap washers, unblocking a drain the tenant blocked) are paid by the tenant. The tenant is told before the job is booked.
